description: ffmpeg commands used to generate the L1 fixture media (run in the fixture root); edit.json is fixture-edit.json
commands: narration n-1..n-6: durations 6,12,30,4,18,9 s, sine (300+i*70) Hz with tremolo, odd i -> mono wav, even i -> aac m4a 128k

ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i "testsrc2=size=1280x720:rate=30:duration=200" -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=500:sample_rate=48000:duration=200" -af "volume=0.3,tremolo=f=3:d=0.8" -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -crf 32 -g 30 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 96k -shortest main.mp4

swap/bgm-a-880.mp3: ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i "aevalsrc='0.3*sin(2*PI*880*t)*(0.6+0.4*sin(2*PI*2*t))|0.3*sin(2*PI*880*t)':s=44100:d=210" -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 192k (same byte size as bgm-a.mp3, different mtime)
bands: 220 Hz = bgm-a, 196 Hz = bgm-b, 500 Hz = embedded speech of main.mp4, 880 Hz = swapped bgm-a
